featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience with Zeno Emergency Medicine. The instructors were highly knowledgeable and ensured active participation throughout the sessions. Their instructions and explanations were clear, making the concepts easy to understand and apply.

The BLS training was demonstrated effectively using mannequins, which made the learning very practical and hands-on. The ACLS guidelines were also explained in detail, following the latest 2025 protocols.

The team was extremely supportive, providing constant motivation and encouragement. The facilities were well-equipped, with high-quality mannequins and equipment that enhanced the overall learning experience.

Overall, a very enriching and well organized training program.

featured_reviews.name: Finlay Marak
featured_reviews.review_text: Came here for BLS and ACLS training. Zen plus pvt is an AHA recognised International training center. Dr Narasinh Arolkar has been in touch with me since the time I was registering for the course and helped me throughout the course through detailed teachings, explained every equipments in detail. Akshay has been helpful since day 1 till my last day. Drs Leena and Swapnil gave positive feedbacks which helped me to improve. Even though I came from Meghalaya for this course, it was worth the travel to learn under friendly, patient and knowledgeable instructors at a great place. Everything I learned was according to the latest guidelines. Applying algorithms has now become easier.

featured_reviews.name: Aaliya Mehmood
featured_reviews.review_text: I attended 3 days comprehensive BLS and ACLS workshop at Zenzo prvt ltd in Mumbai and it was a highly immersive experience. They have certified instructors who are extremely knowledgeable and seamlessly guide you. As BLS and ACLS is almost mandatory for clinical practice for every healthcare professional, I  would highly recommend this centre as the value depends heavily on where you do it (quality of training centre matters a lot).

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Rao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Bad service, we had requested for ambulance by 4pm, but it came after 5.17 pm
Driver did not know the pickup or hospital address even though we specifically mentioned and even then the driver went to some other location, asked do I have to come there and we had to deal with way too many calls , took way too many calls to reach. Once dispatched the ambulance service didn't bother to pick calls. Despite specifically mentioning that patient was not able to walk or move, the driver came all alone with stretcher in hand saying he could not find anyone else to come along. And they have the audacity to say out of compassion they are calling for feedback after 3 days. Where was that compassion when we booked ambulance? The driver had no idea of how to use maps, dropped the patient half way as he was unable to understand navigation. Despite hip injury the patient had to go walking almost 300 metres. And at a premium rate for a 1.2 km distance. Pathetic behaviour and very bad service. A complete no for emergencies!

After the ambulance arrived, we sent them back. This was the last time that I take their services. WORST experience!

featured_reviews.name: Poojan Makani
featured_reviews.review_text: We used Ziqitza service to transport my father twice, from hospital to his residence and later from his residence to our home. The drivers were well prepared and very professional. They arrived on time and at no time did we feel rushed. I can highly recommend the service.”

featured_reviews.name: Sujeet Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: My husband often needs to be carried for routine health check-ups, Ziqitza Healthcare Ltd Ambulance service has been a part of our daily life. The staff and doctors are very kind and humble, they take care of the patient till the last minute i.e. until the patient gets admitted/ receives adequate medical help, I am really thankful to them.

featured_reviews.name: Heinz Doofenshmirtz
featured_reviews.review_text: Ambulance staff was trustworthy and polite. It has been years since I have met people with such great dedication. Highly recommended!! Taken an ambulance from Udaipur, Rajasthan to Ahmedabad, Gujarat for my father surgery Thanks to the team

featured_reviews.name: Sanchit Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Team Ziqitza helped organize a private ambulance for my brother infected with the coronavirus. Whether it was coordinating with the hospital where he was admitted or dealing with health authorities and other on ground challenges, they helped me in every way they could for a seamless and safe intercity transfer. Day or night they always responded positively & provided quick support. My brother got further treatment and is safe now. This couldn’t have happened without Ziqitza .Thanks a lot. Mr. Ankur Kamboj

featured_reviews.name: Anjali Goyal
featured_reviews.review_text: A few days back my neighbor was admitted in one nursing home in Virar. Due to his health issue he was suggested to admit in big institute and for transferring him we need cardiac ambulance so we took the help of Ziqitza and within 15 minutes it arrived and the rate was almost half of what others quoted us, so I recommend their service toeveryone to in an emergency.

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Godse
featured_reviews.review_text: Best and most trustworthy services to shift patient by ambulance. The most professional thing that i noticed that while shifting my uncle from siliguri to delhi is they shift patient bed to bed with everything preplanned so we dont have to arrange anything from our side and shifting process is performed smoothly. Their was no tension in our family as their employees work carefully and always with smiling faces.

featured_reviews.name: Krishang Arora
featured_reviews.review_text: My wife was suffering from labour pain, we had called an ambulance and rushed to the hospital in Katak, Odisha. At this time, I was unaware but my wallet had fallen inside the vehicle and on reaching the hospital, we were left helpless. However the staff in the ambulance immediately returned the wallet and we were able to make the necessary payments to the hospital. We are really grateful for the immediate services rendered and appreciate the honesty that the staff displayed. Mr Shyam Jain
